# LessonAI - AI Lesson Plan Generator

> LessonAI is a free, AI-powered web application that generates professional, curriculum-aligned lesson plans for teachers, students, and professionals in seconds. It is built by NorthReason.

## Key Features
- Instant generation of structured lesson plans.
- Supports multiple curriculums: Common Core, IB, British, and General.
- Translates lesson plans into over 100 global languages.
- Allows custom duration, grade levels, and learning objectives.
- No signup or registration required.
